title: GLM-5.4 Designs a Robot Arm in FreeCAD

news.label: GLM-5.4 Now Handles CAD Design Too
details: It's a Loop Transformer in a model of about 750 billion parameters, passing 28 layers through twice to deepen reasoning without adding parameters.
Beyond game creation and GLSL shader 3D scenes, it also demonstrated designing a six axis robot arm in FreeCAD.
The claim that it rivals models with two to three trillion parameters comes from the maker, and the model weights and pay as you go API are still only planned for release.

lines.say: First up, GLM five point four from Z dot A I.
It runs the same layers twice to think more deeply.

news.label: Gemini API Can Read Parts of Files
points: Loads only the parts you need
details: On the server side, it can load just the needed parts of PDFs, Office documents, audio, video, and more.
You can specify page ranges, cell ranges, and video time ranges or resolution, and a file you upload once can be reused across multiple tasks.
In pre-release testing by LiteLLM, one example cut PDF prompt tokens by 67 percent.

lines.say: Next, Google's Gemini A P I.
It can now load just the parts of a document that you need.

lines.say: That could help keep costs down, even with big files.

news.label: Share 3DGS with VDC Viewer
points: Auto-optimizes tens of millions of points
details: It automatically optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting data with tens of millions of points, so you can view and share it in a browser or on a tablet.
It supports overlaying 3DGS on design models, distance measurement, and annotations.
It's a cloud service supporting PLY, SPZ, GLB, FBX, STL, and more, with pricing starting at 50,000 yen a month.

news.label: NVIDIA Brings GPUs to DuckDB
details: NVIDIA and DuckLabs have published how to use Sirius, a GPU native SQL engine for DuckDB.
With DuckDB two point zero and a supported GPU, you install it with just two commands, INSTALL sirius and LOAD sirius, and you don't need to rewrite your SQL.
On the TPC-H benchmark, a two GPU setup is reported to be 3.25 to 5.50 times faster than a CPU setup. Results vary with data size and queries.

lines.say: It's an extension that speeds up DuckDB using your GPU.

news.label: cuDSS 1.0 Brings GPUs to CAE
points: Up to 151 times faster in one stage
details: A technical explainer has been published on cuDSS 1.0, which solves the sparse systems of linear equations used in product design and scientific computing on the GPU.
It targets structural analysis, fluid analysis, thermal analysis, circuit simulation, and more.
Compared with Intel MKL, the triangular solve stage ran 151 times faster. That doesn't mean the whole simulation is 151 times faster.
